title: Thirteen Results in Magnitude Theory
summary: We prove thirteen results concerning three aspects of magnitude theory. The first four concern small-scale magnitude and microscopic weightings. We identify the derivative of the magnitude function at the origin with maximal energy, allowing the value $+\infty$, and construct finite spaces for which small-scale magnitude diverges or for which the one-point property and finite concentration do not produce a microscopic weighting.
